summary: FEAT-042 normalized: user-scoped operation history with combined filter and pagination; criteria derived for reload persistence and empty state.
checked_criteria: Snapshot hash matches the stored source snapshot
Every intent of the original request (history, filter, pagination) appears in goal or criteria
Constraints include existing login and tenant isolation
Requested operations are within the local mode permission scope

payload.goal: A signed-in user can find their own earlier operation in a filterable, paginated history.
acceptance_criteria: The user sees only their own operations.
Filter and pagination work together, also after a page reload.
With no operations the history shows an empty state instead of an error.
Requesting another user's operations via the API returns no foreign rows.
constraints: Use the existing login (session cookie auth in src/auth/session.py)
Do not expose data of other users

decisions.question: How many operations per history page?
decisions.why: Sets the page size, the pagination controls and the paging tests.
decisions.proposed: 20, the page size of the existing lists in src/web/lists
